# Test: Update EVE from split-rootfs to a newer split-rootfs OCI image
# Scenario: split -> split (A/B partition swap, both have Extension)
#
# Precondition: device is already running a split-rootfs EVE
#   (from the update_eve_image_split test).
#
# This test pushes a second split-rootfs version and verifies that:
# - The new Core activates on the other partition slot
# - The new Extension is paired with the new active slot
# - extsloader reaches "ready" state
# - dm-verity root hash is present
#
# Env vars:
#   EVE_VERSION_2 - second split-rootfs EVE version tag (required)
#   EVE_REGISTRY  - OCI registry path (default: lfedge/eve)

# Second split-rootfs version to update to
{{$eve_ver := "0.0.0"}}

# Default EVE registry
{{$eve_registry := "lfedge/eve"}}

# Obtain EVE_VERSION_2 from environment
{{$env := EdenGetEnv "EVE_VERSION_2"}}
{{if $env}}{{$eve_ver = $env}}{{end}}

# Obtain EVE_REGISTRY from environment (e.g. "myuser/eve")
{{$env_reg := EdenGetEnv "EVE_REGISTRY"}}
{{if $env_reg}}{{$eve_registry = $env_reg}}{{end}}

{{$eve_hv := "kvm"}}
{{$eve_arch := EdenConfig "eve.arch"}}
{{$short_version := printf "%s-%s-%s" $eve_ver $eve_hv $eve_arch}}
{{$test_info := "test eden.lim.test -test.v -timewait 30m -test.run TestInfo"}}

# ── Step 1: Verify currently on split image ──────────────────
message 'Split->Split: verifying current split state...'
eden eve ssh 'test -f /hostfs/etc/ext-verity-roothash && echo split || echo monolithic'
stdout 'split'
exec -t 5m bash wait-extsloader.sh

# ── Step 2: Send update to second split image ────────────────
eden controller edge-node update --config timer.test.baseimage.update=30

message 'Split->Split: sending update request'
eden -t 10m controller edge-node eveimage-update oci://docker.io/{{$eve_registry}}:{{$eve_ver}}-{{$eve_hv}}-{{$eve_arch}} -m adam://
! stderr .

# ── Step 3: Wait for activation ──────────────────────────────
message 'Split->Split: waiting for update to activate...'
{{$test_info}} -out InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].ShortVersion 'InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].PartitionState:active InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].ShortVersion:{{ $short_version }}'
stdout '{{ $short_version }}'

# ── Step 4: Wait for Extension services (SSH from debug container) ──
message 'Split->Split: waiting for Extension services (SSH)...'
exec -t 5m bash wait-ssh.sh

# ── Step 5: Verify split state on new version ────────────────
message 'Split->Split: verifying Extension loaded...'

message 'Split->Split: waiting for extsloader ready state...'
exec -t 5m bash wait-extsloader.sh

eden eve ssh 'test -f /hostfs/etc/ext-verity-roothash && echo present || echo missing'
stdout 'present'

eden eve ssh 'ls /persist/ext-img*.img'
stdout 'ext-img'

eden eve ssh 'mountpoint -q /persist/exts && echo mounted || echo not-mounted'
stdout 'mounted'

message 'Split->Split: SUCCESS'

# Test's config file
-- eden-config.yml --
test:
    controller: adam://{{EdenConfig "adam.ip"}}:{{EdenConfig "adam.port"}}
    eve:
      {{EdenConfig "eve.name"}}:
        onboard-cert: {{EdenConfigPath "eve.cert"}}
        serial: "{{EdenConfig "eve.serial"}}"
        model: {{EdenConfig "eve.devmodel"}}

-- wait-ssh.sh --
EDEN={{EdenConfig "eden.root"}}/{{EdenConfig "eden.bin-dist"}}/{{EdenConfig "eden.eden-bin"}}
i=0
while [ $i -lt 30 ]; do
    if timeout 10 $EDEN eve ssh echo ssh-ready 2>/dev/null; then
        exit 0
    fi
    sleep 5
    i=$((i + 1))
done
echo "SSH not available after 150s"
exit 1

-- wait-extsloader.sh --
EDEN={{EdenConfig "eden.root"}}/{{EdenConfig "eden.bin-dist"}}/{{EdenConfig "eden.eden-bin"}}
i=0
while [ $i -lt 24 ]; do
    STATE=$($EDEN eve ssh 'cat /run/extsloader-state.json 2>/dev/null' 2>/dev/null)
    if echo "$STATE" | grep -q '"state":"ready"'; then
        echo "$STATE"
        exit 0
    fi
    echo "Waiting for extsloader ready (attempt $((i+1))/24)... current: $STATE"
    sleep 10
    i=$((i + 1))
done
echo "extsloader not ready after 240s"
echo "Last state: $STATE"
exit 1
